title: Release discussion
content: Annie confirmed that the production release remains planned for 15 October 2026 unless final validation fails.

title: Validation reminder
content: Reminder: release validation must be finished by 14 October so the 15 October deployment can proceed.

title: VPN troubleshooting discussion
content: The IT team recommends restarting the VPN client and clearing stale sessions before escalating persistent login failures.

title: Architecture migration discussion
content: The network architecture team discussed the Q4 edge migration sequence and agreed to keep the detailed rollout private until final approval.

title: Security incident update
content: Security Operations confirmed that investigation of the critical authentication incident is still ongoing.
